thread:
sarah: Quick async rollup on dedicated capacity — noticed a couple reservation gaps for next month's on‑prem ramp. TL;DR: procurement ETA slipped for 8x H100 nodes, SS1 rack power test still pending, and we need owners for fallback routing + canary policy.
kevin: ack. which reservations specifically? link to the table?
sarah: the reservation manifest in the drive — updated rows below (edited to show only affected lines):
```
region:rack, sku, qty, reserved_until
us-west-2:ss1, h100-80gb, 8, 2026-04-15
us-east-1:ss3, h100-80gb, 16, 2026-05-01
us-west-2:ss1, fallback_pool, 4, 2026-04-01
```
The us-west-2:ss1 H100 shipment moved from 4/10 -> 4/22 per vendor mail (TICKET-3284). fallback_pool was a soft reserve we assumed but not committed.
miguel: thanks — vendor note seen in TICKET-3284. That pushes our canary window later unless we use cross-region fallbacks.
priya: quick Q — do we have enough capacity in us-east to cover the canary for the SS1 workloads if we route there? What about latency SLO impact?
jess: today's perf deck shows us-east adds ~12–18ms p50 for those models; acceptable for staging canary but not prod SLA. We should only use it for canaries and QA.
kevin: proposal: use us-east for canary (non-prod) and keep fallback_pool (4 GPUs) for quick customer-facing rollouts — but need confirmed commit on fallback_pool reservation.
sarah: ownership ask: @miguel can you take procurement followup with vendor and confirm new ETAs + written commit? @priya can you take routing policy changes (canary -> us-east, prod -> wait or degraded-mode)?
miguel: I can ping vendor this morning. ETA to update TICKET-3284 by EOD today. I'll ask for partial shipment if possible.
priya: I can sketch the routing policy change. Draft rule: route canary traffic to us-east if us-west-2 cluster < 90% healthy. Add experiment flag `routing.canary.cross_region:true`. Will open PR, pinging @jess for perf verification before merge.
kevin: please add the rollback condition in the PR: if p95 latency > baseline+30ms then revert. Also include a throttling cap of 10% traffic for cross-region canary.
jess: will run perf matrix after PR is up. FYI there is a flaky test in the perf harness; I'll file PERF-789.
priya: opening PR now: https://git.company/prs/4521 (will add reviewers: kevin, jess, sarah).
sarah: thanks. small ops ask: we still need rack power test on SS1 — that's blocking full node bringup. Ops running test tomorrow per #infra-schedule.
kevin: who owns follow through on rack test? @jess or @miguel?
miguel: ops will run test but I can be point of contact. I'll be there for the window (9–11am PT). After test passes, we schedule node burn-in.
jess: noted. once burn-in is green, we flip the reserved_until dates and update the manifest. I'll handle burn-in orchestration.
capacity-bot: Reminder: reservation `us-west-2:ss1:h100-80gb` moved -> 2026-04-22 (recorded). See TICKET-3284.
sarah: next steps recap: (1) @miguel vendor confirmation EOD + update ticket, (2) @priya open PR for routing + experiment flag (#4521) and add rollback bounds, (3) ops run rack power test tomorrow (miguel on call), (4) @jess run perf validation + burn-in orchestration. Anyone want to add or change?
kevin: can we add an explicit timeline for rollback decision — within first 30 minutes of canary? otherwise risk noisy errors.
priya: will add a 30m monitoring window in the PR and alert policy to the canary runbook.
sarah: perfect. I'll update the shared manifest and send a short nudge to sales/support about potential soft delays for dedicated customers. I'll post a short status update in the 9am standup channel too.
miguel: pinged vendor — they said customs hold might add 3–5 business days. I'm asking for partial release of 4 nodes.
jess: ok, documented. I'll tag PERF-789 in the PR and set expected perf check time (2h) after PR merge.
kevin: thanks all. if anything changes ping here or DM. :thumbsup:
